<objective>
Sync a branch from its base with interactive conflict resolution, run the project's exact CI gate set locally, delegate review to harness-code-review, then classify every finding by ORIGIN (introduced by this branch vs pre-existing on the base) into a dated report and auto-fix only the in-scope ones after one approval

Phases:

- intake: Resolve identity, base ref, flags and run directory; resume from a prior state.json if present; guard against a dirty tree
- sync: Fetch and merge the base ref, resolving every conflict interactively — even the obvious ones — then run a post-merge semantic smoke check
- mechanical: Run the project's configured gate set (skills.branchBuster.gates) in CI order with the CI baseline, and build the exclusion set; zero configured gates abstains rather than passing
- scope-calibrate: Compute the three-dot diff, change type, depth tier, context bundles, blast radius and hotspots; log what a bounded sweep did not cover
- fan-out: Delegate the generic review fan-out to harness-code-review, and dispatch only the project's own configured lenses (skills.branchBuster.lenses) alongside it — never a second copy of the generic roster
- validate-dedup: Exclude mechanical duplicates, verify reachability, adversarially refute high-severity findings, apply the learnings filter, then dedup and merge
- classify-report: Classify every surviving finding by origin, type and severity; write the dated report; take exactly one informed fix-plan approval
- fix: Auto-fix branch-scoped clear findings, ask on entangled and pre-existing ones, re-verify per batch
- verify-finalize: Re-run the full gate set to prove the branch green, update the report, restore any stash, and hand off
  </objective>
